arxiv-1804-09568.title: Search for lepton-flavor-violating decays of the Z Z boson into a τ \tau lepton and a light lepton with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1804-09568.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1804-09568.description: Abstract Direct searches for lepton flavor violation in decays of the Z Z boson with the ATLAS detector at the LHC are presented. Decays of the Z Z boson into an electron or muon and a hadronically decaying τ \tau lepton are considered.

arxiv-2107-00982.title: Anomalous Gilbert Damping and Duffing Features of the SFS 𝝋 𝟎 \varphi_{0} Josephson Junction
arxiv-2107-00982.creator: Yu. M. Shukrinov 1,2, I. R. Rahmonov 1,3, A. Janalizadeh 4, M. R. Kolahchi 4
arxiv-2107-00982.description: Abstract We demonstrate unusual features of phase dynamics, IV-characteristics and magnetization dynamics of the φ 0 \varphi_{0} Josephson junction at small values of spin-orbit interaction, ratio of Josephson to magnetic energy and Gilbert damping. In particular, an anomalous shift of the ferromagnetic resonance frequency with an increase of Gilbert damping is found.

arxiv-2208-05813.title: Stiefel-Whitney Classes of representations of SL ⁡ ( 2 , q ) \SL(2,q)
arxiv-2208-05813.creator: Neha Malik, Steven Spallone
arxiv-2208-05813.description: Abstract . We describe the Stiefel-Whitney classes (SWCs) of orthogonal representations π \pi of the finite special linear groups G = SL ⁡ ( 2 , 𝔽 q ) G=\SL(2,\mathbb{F}_{q}) , in terms of character values of π \pi . From this calculation, we can answer interesting questions about SWCs of π \pi .

arxiv-2309-11193.title: RHALE: Robust and Heterogeneity-aware Accumulated Local Effects
arxiv-2309-11193.creator: Vasilis Gkolemis, Theodore Dalamagas, Eirini Ntoutsi, Christos Diou
arxiv-2309-11193.description: Abstract Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) is a widely-used explainability method for isolating the average effect of a feature on the output, because it handles cases with correlated features well. However, it has two limitations. First, it does not quantify the deviation of instance-level (local) effects from the average (global) effect, known as heterogeneity.

arxiv-2312-15157.title: CodeScholar: Growing Idiomatic Code Examples
arxiv-2312-15157.creator: Manish Shetty, Koushik Sen, Ion Stoica
arxiv-2312-15157.description: Abstract . Programmers often search for usage examples for API methods. A tool that could generate realistic, idiomatic, and contextual usage examples for one or more APIs would be immensely beneficial to developers. Such a tool would relieve the need for a deep understanding of the API landscape, augment existing documentation, and help discover interactions among APIs.

arxiv-2407-18137.title: XS-VID: An Extremely Small Video Object Detection Dataset
arxiv-2407-18137.creator: Jiahao Guo, Ziyang Xu, Lianjun Wu, Fei Gao, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
arxiv-2407-18137.description: Abstract Small Video Object Detection (SVOD) is a crucial subfield in modern computer vision, essential for early object discovery and detection. However, existing SVOD datasets are scarce and suffer from issues such as insufficiently small objects, limited object categories, and lack of scene diversity, leading to unitary application scenarios for corresponding methods.

arxiv-2509-03817.title: Learning to Deliberate: Meta-policy Collaboration for Agentic LLMs with Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2509-03817.creator: Wei Yang, Jesse Thomason
arxiv-2509-03817.description: Abstract Multi-agent systems of large language models (LLMs) show promise for complex reasoning, but their effectiveness is often limited by fixed collaboration protocols. These frameworks typically focus on macro-level orchestration while overlooking agents’ internal deliberative capabilities. This critical meta-cognitive blindspot treats agents as passive executors unable to adapt their strategy based on internal cognitive states like uncertainty or confidence.

arxiv-2509-18949.title: Towards Privacy-Aware Bayesian Networks: A Credal Approach
arxiv-2509-18949.creator: Niccolò Rocchi, Fabio Stella, Cassio de Campos
arxiv-2509-18949.description: Abstract Bayesian networks (BN) are versatile probabilistic graphical models that enable efficient knowledge representation and inference. These models have proven effective across diverse domains, including healthcare, bioinformatics, economics, law, and image processing. The structure and parameters of a BN can be obtained by domain experts or directly learned from available data.

arxiv-2510-12747.title: FlashVSR: Towards Real-time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Super-Resolution
arxiv-2510-12747.creator: Junhao Zhuang, Shi Guo, Xin Cai, Xiaohui Li, Yihao Liu, Chun Yuan, Tianfan Xue
arxiv-2510-12747.description: Abstract Diffusion models have recently advanced video restoration, but applying them to real-world video super-resolution (VSR) remains challenging due to high latency, prohibitive computation, and poor generalization to ultra-high resolutions. Our goal in this work is to make diffusion-based VSR practical by achieving efficiency, scalability, and real-time performance.

arxiv-2601-04060.title: ComfySearch: Autonomous Exploration and Reasoning for ComfyUI Workflows
arxiv-2601-04060.creator: Jinwei Su, Qizhen Lan, ZEYU WANG, Yinghui Xia
arxiv-2601-04060.description: Abstract AI-generated content has progressed from monolithic models to modular workflows, especially on platforms like ComfyUI, allowing users to customize complex creative pipelines. However, the large number of components in ComfyUI and the difficulty of maintaining long-horizon structural consistency under strict graph constraints frequently lead to low pass rates and workflows of limited quality.

pmc-11390718.title: The role of affective control, strategy repertoire and subjective emotion regulation success in developmental internalising psychopathology
pmc-11390718.creator: Carolin C. L. M. Herber, Lea L. Lott-Sandkamp, Elisa R. Straub, Brunna Tuschen-Caffier
pmc-11390718.description: Adolescence poses significant challenges for emotion regulation (ER) and is thus a critical phase in the emergence of various mental disorders, specifically internalising disorders such as anxiety and depression. Affective control, defined as the application of cognitive control in affective contexts, is crucial for effective ER. However, the relationship between ER and affective control is unclear.

pmc-11674610.title: Ex Vivo Fluorescence Confocal Microscopy Meets Innovation and Revolutionary Technology, for “Real-Time” Histological Evaluation, in Pediatric Surgical Oncology
pmc-11674610.creator: Donatella Di Fabrizio, Edoardo Bindi, Michele Ilari, Alessandra Filosa, Gaia Goteri, Giovanni Cobellis, Quentin Ballouhey
pmc-11674610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Aim: Ex vivo fluorescence confocal microscopy (FCM) systems are innovative optical imaging tools that create virtual high-resolution histological images without any standard tissue processing, either freezing or fixing in formalin and embedding in paraffin. These systems have opened an era that would revolutionize pathological examination by providing rapid, real-time assessments across various pathology subspecialties, potentially replacing conventional methods that are tissue- and time-consuming.

pmc-12361630.title: Association Between Acute COVID‐19 Infection and Long COVID in a Non‐Hospitalized Population: A Retrospective Case‐Control Study
pmc-12361630.creator: Nicolás Escrivá, Laura Moreno‐Galarraga, Elena Barado, María Gabriela Torres, Alejandro Fernandez‐Montero
pmc-12361630.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and AimsLong COVID (LC) is a condition characterized by the persistence of physical or psychological symptoms after acute SARS‐CoV‐2 infection. While its pathophysiology remains unclear, it is essential to identify acute‐phase risk factors associated with its development.

pmc-12606234.title: A multi-factor data mining and transformer-based predictive modeling approach for career success using educational and behavioral traits
pmc-12606234.creator: Zhao Zihan
pmc-12606234.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation are increasingly transforming the job market, necessitating advanced methods to enhance job opportunities and career satisfaction for students. In this context, data mining plays a crucial role by uncovering hidden patterns and relationships within large-scale educational and behavioral datasets, enabling more accurate and data-driven insights.

pmc-12616499.title: Lateralization Disruption and Dynamic Balance Alterations in Alzheimer's Disease: Impacts on Hemispheric Interaction and Cognitive Performance
pmc-12616499.creator: Juan Wang, Yuxin Li, Yu Yang, Zhenhu Liang, Ping Xie, Xiaoli Li, Yina Guo, Shaobao Li, Xiaoling Chen
pmc-12616499.description: Brain lateralization is considered evolutionarily adaptive. Impaired functional specialization is thought to cause abnormal lateralization in neurological disorders. However, the dynamic changes in brain laterality in Alzheimer's disease (AD) remain unclear. In this study, resting‐state fMRI data and neuropsychological assessments from 109 participants (49 ad patients and 60 healthy controls [HC]) were used.

pmc-12633964.title: Diagnostic accuracy of Truenat in extrapulmonary tuberculosis
pmc-12633964.creator: Abhisek Das, Saswat Subhankar, C. Mohan Rao, Amrut Kumar Mohapatra, Sunil Swick Rout, Surya Teja Meka, Yashaswi R. Bharadwaj Akkiraju
pmc-12633964.description: Background:Diagnosing extrapulmonary tuberculosis (EPTB) remains a challenge even in today’s era. Truenat, an indigenously developed nucleic acid amplification test (NAAT), has reported high sensitivity and specificity in sputum samples. However, its role in EPTB is still debatable.Objective:To compare the efficacy of Truenat with other diagnostic modalities, like acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear, mycobacterial culture, and a composite reference standard.

pmc-13369734.creator: P A Holzner, C Berlin, S Fichtner-Feigl, M M Menzel, B Acidi, S Caringi, M Gelli, R Memeo
pmc-13369734.description: BackgroundSingle port (SP) robotic surgery is the latest innovation in robotic surgery. Published evidence is limited and few series are available for SP robotic hepatectomy. The aim of this study was to investigate early feasibility of SP robotic hepatectomy in Europe.
